project_overview.title: Flaviu Workspace (workspace.flaviu.dev)
project_overview.type: saas_app / developer tools workspace / admin panel
project_overview.target_user: Flaviu & System Administrators needing high-efficiency DevOps and server management tools
project_overview.key_flow: 1. Key Authentication (20-character access key) -> 2. Telemetry Loading Screen (animated initialization sequence) -> 3. Swiss Minimalist Dashboard Panel with extensible developer tool cards

design_archetype.name: Swiss Modern Minimalist (Archetype 4 - High Contrast Authority)
design_archetype.theme: Light Mode Primary (Zinc & Crisp Slate with Monospaced Telemetry Details)
aesthetic_principles: Tactile Swiss Precision: High grid density, crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200), zero unnecessary heavy gradients
Monospace Data Accents: JetBrains Mono for system metrics, domain records, status indicators, and key inputs
Asymmetric Bento Grid: Feature tool cards laid out in structured, responsive proportions
Micro-Interactions: Spring physics on card hover, glowing crisp focus states, terminal-style step transitions

typography.primary_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / DM Sans (Clean Geometric Sans for headers and UI labels)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (For 20-char Key Input, DNS Records, Server Paths, and Terminal Output)

hierarchy.tool_card_title: text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2
hierarchy.badge_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 font-medium

auth_and_login_spec.subtitle: Enter your 20-character developer authorization key to unlock workspace utilities

input_specification.format: 5 groups of 4 characters or 20 raw alphanumeric characters (e.g. FLAV-2026-SYNC-DNSX-9821)
input_specification.helper_text: Demo Key available: FLAV-2026-SRV1-SYNC-9X0A or enter any 20-char key

auth_and_login_spec.visual_design: Minimalist centered Swiss card with subtle grid line background, security badge, and instant validation response

stages: Initializing IMAP Sync Engine & cPanel FTP connector...
loading_screen_spec.visual_elements: Monospace progress percentage, pulse indicator, diagnostic console output line, sleek progress bar (Sky-600)

core_tools.title: DNS Zone Lookup
core_tools.description: Query live DNS zone records (A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain with TTL diagnostic parsing.
core_tools.interactive_preview: Domain input (e.g., flaviu.dev), record filter toggles, DNS server selector (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8), simulated live output table.

core_tools.title: IMAP Mail Sync
core_tools.description: Synchronize mailboxes between two IMAP accounts with folder mapping, delta comparison, and sync progress logs.
core_tools.interactive_preview: Source Account Form (Server, Port, User, Pass) -> Destination Account Form -> Dry Run & Sync Execution panel.

core_tools.title: cPanel File Migration
core_tools.romanian_title: Migrarea fișierelor dintr-un cPanel în altul
core_tools.description: Automated migration of public_html, MySQL databases, and configuration files between source and destination cPanel instances.
core_tools.interactive_preview: cPanel API / Host credentials form, backup compression selector, migration progress bar, directory preview.

core_tools.title: SSL & Domain Health Monitor
core_tools.description: Inspect SSL certificate expiration dates, OCSP stapling status, and HTTP/2 handshake benchmarks.
core_tools.interactive_preview: Domain status cards with expiry countdown bars.

core_tools.title: MySQL / PostgreSQL Dump & Restore
core_tools.description: One-click compressed database dump generation, remote server restoration, and table structure comparison.
core_tools.interactive_preview: Database connection string input with export format options (.sql.gz, .tar).

core_tools.title: Custom Script Executor & Webhooks
core_tools.description: Configure and execute custom Bash/Python server automation scripts directly from your workspace dashboard.
core_tools.interactive_preview: Script selection dropdown with parameter inputs and live console execution output.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the multi-state React application inside /app/frontend/src/App.js (or modular components under /app/frontend/src/components/).

Implement 3 distinct visual states: State 1 = Key Authorization Page (20-char key validation + demo key auto-fill), State 2 = Telemetry Loading Screen (2-second high precision progress animation), State 3 = Full Swiss Panel Dashboard.

Include fully interactive detail drawers or modal dialogs for each of the 3 primary tools ('DNS Zone Lookup', 'IMAP Mail Sync', 'cPanel File Migration') allowing the user to experience real UI workflows.
Add a Command Palette (Ctrl+K or button) that allows quick searching through tools and running quick actions.
Add a toggle or indicator for workspace session key status (e.g. 'Session active: Key FLAV-2026-****').
Use Lucide-react icons for tool categories and indicators.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have precise data-testid attributes specified in testing_and_data_testids.
Maintain the Swiss Minimalist Light Theme: clear high contrast, subtle borders, whitespace padding (p-6, p-8), no heavy dark gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp Swiss rectangular buttons with subtle hover state transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-6, p-8). Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interactive element MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
